shop_profile.name: CoreByte Computers
shop_profile.note: CoreByte Computers is a fictional shop created for the PUSL 3205 LoRA fine-tuning lab. All details are invented and internally consistent so the model has a clear domain to learn.

qa_pairs.question: What are your opening hours?
qa_pairs.answer: CoreByte Computers is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 7 PM, and Saturday from 10 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

qa_pairs.question: Are you open on weekends?
qa_pairs.answer: We are open on Saturdays from 10 AM to 5 PM, but we are closed on Sundays.

qa_pairs.question: What time do you close on weekdays?
qa_pairs.answer: On weekdays, Monday to Friday, we close at 7 PM.

qa_pairs.question: Where is CoreByte Computers located?
qa_pairs.answer: We are located at 48 Harbour Street, Galle. You will find us a short walk from the main bus stand.

qa_pairs.question: How can I contact the shop?
qa_pairs.answer: You can call us on +94 91 223 4567 or email hello@corebyte.lk. We usually reply to emails within one business day.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell laptops?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we stock a wide range of laptops from brands like ASUS, Lenovo, HP, and Acer, covering everything from budget study laptops to high-end gaming machines.

qa_pairs.question: What is the cheapest laptop you have?
qa_pairs.answer: Our most affordable laptops start at around LKR 95,000. These are great for browsing, documents, and online classes.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell gaming PCs?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we build and sell custom gaming PCs. Prices typically range from LKR 250,000 for an entry-level build to over LKR 700,000 for a high-end rig.

qa_pairs.question: Can you build a custom PC for me?
qa_pairs.answer: Absolutely. Custom PC builds are our specialty. Tell us your budget and what you need it for, and we will recommend a parts list. The assembly service costs LKR 7,500 on top of the parts.

qa_pairs.question: How much is the custom build assembly fee?
qa_pairs.answer: Our assembly fee for a custom PC build is LKR 7,500, which includes cable management, OS installation, and basic stress testing.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell computer parts separately?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we sell individual components including CPUs, GPUs, motherboards, RAM, storage drives, power supplies, and cooling.

qa_pairs.question: Do you have graphics cards in stock?
qa_pairs.answer: We regularly stock graphics cards from NVIDIA and AMD. Availability changes often, so please call us on +94 91 223 4567 to check the latest stock before visiting.

qa_pairs.question: How much does a 16GB RAM stick cost?
qa_pairs.answer: A 16GB DDR4 RAM module costs around LKR 14,500, and 16GB DDR5 is around LKR 19,000, depending on the brand and speed.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell SSDs?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. A 500GB NVMe SSD starts at around LKR 13,000, and a 1TB NVMe SSD is around LKR 23,000.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell monitors?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we stock monitors from 22-inch office displays to 27-inch high-refresh gaming monitors, starting at about LKR 32,000.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell keyboards and mice?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we have a full range of keyboards and mice, including mechanical keyboards and wireless sets, starting from LKR 2,500.

qa_pairs.question: What warranty do your products come with?
qa_pairs.answer: Most new products come with a standard 1-year warranty. Custom-built PCs carry a 1-year warranty on the build and labour, plus each component's own manufacturer warranty.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer extended warranty?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can purchase an extended warranty that adds a second year of cover for 8% of the product price, available at the time of purchase.

qa_pairs.question: Is accidental damage covered by the warranty?
qa_pairs.answer: No, our standard warranty covers manufacturing defects only. Accidental damage such as drops or liquid spills is not covered, but we can still repair it as a paid service.

qa_pairs.question: How do I claim a warranty repair?
qa_pairs.answer: Bring the product and your receipt to the shop. We will log it and, for valid warranty claims, there is no charge for parts or labour. Turnaround is usually 3 to 7 working days.

qa_pairs.question: Do you repair computers?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we repair laptops and desktops, including hardware faults, software issues, virus removal, and upgrades, whether or not you bought the machine from us.

qa_pairs.question: How much is a diagnostic check?
qa_pairs.answer: A full diagnostic check costs LKR 2,000. If you go ahead with the repair at our shop, the diagnostic fee is deducted from the final repair cost.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a typical repair take?
qa_pairs.answer: Most repairs are completed within 3 to 7 working days. If we need to order a part, we will tell you the expected wait before starting.

qa_pairs.question: Can you recover data from a dead hard drive?
qa_pairs.answer: We offer data recovery for failed drives. Basic logical recovery starts at LKR 6,000, and we will quote you before proceeding. Severe physical damage may need a specialist lab.

qa_pairs.question: Can you upgrade my laptop's RAM or storage?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, if your laptop supports it. RAM and SSD upgrades are common; the labour charge is LKR 2,500 plus the cost of the parts.

qa_pairs.question: Do you remove viruses and reinstall Windows?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. Virus removal and a clean Windows reinstall cost LKR 3,500, and we back up your files first if the drive is readable.

qa_pairs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
qa_pairs.answer: We accept cash, all major debit and credit cards, and bank transfers. For custom builds we ask for a 50% deposit up front.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer installment plans?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we offer 3, 6, and 12-month installment plans through partnered banks on purchases above LKR 100,000, subject to card eligibility.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer a student discount?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, students get 5% off accessories and peripherals with a valid student ID. The discount does not apply to laptops or custom builds already on promotion.

qa_pairs.question: Do you deliver?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we deliver island-wide. Delivery within Galle is free; elsewhere in Sri Lanka it is a flat LKR 600, usually arriving in 2 to 4 working days.

qa_pairs.question: What is your return policy?
qa_pairs.answer: Unopened products can be returned within 7 days with the receipt for a full refund. Opened items may be exchanged within 7 days if faulty, but software and consumables are non-returnable.

qa_pairs.question: Can I return a custom-built PC?
qa_pairs.answer: Custom builds are made to order, so they cannot be returned for a refund. However, they are fully covered by our 1-year build warranty if anything goes wrong.

qa_pairs.question: Do you buy used computers or take trade-ins?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we accept trade-ins against a new purchase. Bring your device in for a free valuation, and we will offer a price based on its condition and age.

qa_pairs.question: Do you sell printers and ink?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we stock inkjet and laser printers along with genuine ink and toner cartridges, starting at around LKR 18,000 for a basic inkjet.

qa_pairs.question: Can you set up a network or Wi-Fi for a small office?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we offer on-site setup for small offices, including routers, switches, and Wi-Fi configuration. On-site service is quoted per job after a quick site survey.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need an appointment to visit?
qa_pairs.answer: No appointment is needed to browse or drop off a repair. For custom build consultations, booking ahead on +94 91 223 4567 means a technician will be ready for you.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer any warranty on repairs you perform?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all our repair work carries a 90-day warranty covering the specific fault we fixed and the parts we supplied for it.
